data.body: Cluster investigation — Track B (INDEPENDENT root cause): NOT a state-file race. test-test-batched.sh uses mktemp -d for every fixture and a hashed git-root namespace (test-batched.sh:202–213), fully isolated from /tmp/merge-to-main-state-*. The test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume flake is timing-dependent: --timeout=1s on a node setInterval test may be killed BEFORE the harness records 'interrupted' under heavy CI load. Recommended fix: bump first-run timeout from 1s to 3s, OR add a 100ms sleep-retry loop checking for non-empty state (same pattern as test-merge-to-main.sh:606-618). Confidence: medium (root cause inferred from isolation evidence; runtime profiling would confirm).
